nodes.question: How do pollution taxes on farmers vary among Member States in the EU?
nodes.answer: Pollution taxes imposed on farmers, particularly applicable to NH3 emissions, vary greatly among Member States, with some imposing low taxes while others have higher rates, indicating a lack of uniformity in applying the "polluter pays" principle.

nodes.question: What percentage of GHG emissions does the agriculture sector contribute according to Parmesan et al. (2022)?
nodes.answer: The agriculture sector contributes approximately 22% of GHG emissions.
